privacy.title: Minimal, privacy-conscious audience measurement.
privacy.lead: This site uses a self-hosted statistics tool to understand useful journeys and improve the portfolio. It does not try to recognise you on a future visit.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.text: Measure use of the chapters, résumés, contact links and assistant solely for the benefit of this portfolio’s publisher. Data is not sold, shared or combined with other services.

data.title: Data processed
data.text: A random identifier limited to the current page load, predefined events, language, a device category and a broad source. No visitor cookie, fingerprint, stored IP address, full User-Agent or conversation content.

retention.title: Hosting and retention
retention.text: Data is hosted on the publisher’s VPS. Detailed events are deleted after 7 days; aggregate statistics are retained for no more than 13 months.
